en: A black-and-white postcard showing a group of soldiers, likely French Zouaves, assembled with rifles and tents outside what appears to be a warehouse or depot building. The architecture is European, with arched windows and a tiled roof. The scene appears to capture a military encampment or staging area, with military personnel preparing or resting. There is overlay text in French and English describing the scene as related to the Balkans during the 1914-15 war.
